attempts.summary: Used Ansible from node2 (the control node, which had ansible-core preinstalled) to repair /srv/inventory on node1: created system group inventory-readers and system user inventorysvc, set recursive ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, and applied 2750 on directories / 0640 on files, removing all "other" access while preserving the existing data files. Verified functionally that a test user in inventory-readers can read the data and a user outside the group is denied. Performed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on both node1 and node2, confirming changed boot IDs and full post-restart recovery of permissions, data, and control-node Ansible connectivity.
